A `Link: <...>; rel="next"` header marks a further page; `ETag` with `If-None-Match` answers 304, and pages may be cached privately for 60 s. `criticality` is null in the list (C3 aggregation rule); `getAsset` carries it.
Audit records in seq order, 500 per page; `subject` narrows to one proposal (or other subject) so a card's History reads its whole ledger in one call.

The March 2025 Table Rock fire weather as of its first Red Flag trigger, read from the committed fixture; independent of the replay clock.
What the signed-in person may do, from the rules the write routes enforce.

A K17 report by name (outage_loso, outage_loso_v2, etr, saa, ladi_reference, anomaly_a7_a8): name, schema_version, created_at, code_version, command, metrics, caveats, provenance. Any other name is a registered model: its card and the K17 metrics of its serving version.
The person's feed: decisions waiting on their function, deadlines within 2 h, signatures, crew sign-offs, stop-level and mode changes, outage surges and published ETRs; read state per user.

Customers out per county in the replayed outage feed at `as_of` (default and upper bound: the scenario clock), the same hour and source as the Briefing total; counties without a report are not listed.
County outage surges from the EAGLE-I CUSUM detector at `as_of` (default and upper bound: the scenario clock); real public 2024 data, label C. 404 when the scenario has no series.
